senses.gloss:
a. (-शी f.) [ईश-अण्] 
__1 Belonging to Śiva; सुरसरिदिव तेजो वह्निनिष्ठपूतमैशम् [[R. 2. 75.]] हास्यश्रीराजहंसा हरतु तनुरिव क्लेशमैशी शरद्वः [[Mu. 1.]] 
__2 Supreme, regal. (ऐशी) N. of the Nakṣatra रोहिणी.

a. [ईशान-अण्] Belonging to Śiva. 
-नी 
__1 The north-eastern direction. 
__2 N. of Durgā.
[Vārt. on [[P. V. 3. 22.]]] ind. During this year, in the present year.
-मस्त्य a. Belonging to the present year.
